'''Zhang Xi''' ({{lang-zh|s=张希}}; born December 1965) is a Chinese chemist and the current president of [[Jilin University]]. He is a chemist and a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/m/2016jilin/2018-12/14/content_37410070.htm|title=Jilin University names new president, China Daily, 2018}}</ref>

==Early life==
Zhang was born in [[Benxi]], [[Liaoning]] in 1965, he received his bachelor's degree in chemistry from [[Jilin University]]. He then received his masters and Ph.D. degrees in chemistry from the same university in 1989 and 1992 respectively.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://zhangxigroup.com/en/Members/Prof.%20Zhang.html|title=Biography of Professor Zhang Xi}}</ref>

==Career==
Zhang became a lecturer at Jilin University from 1993 to 1994. From 1994 to 2003, he became a professor of chemistry at the same university. Since 2003, he has been a professor of chemistry at [[Tsinghua University]] in Beijing, China.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.chem.tsinghua.edu.cn/publish/chemen/2141/2011/20110406161236156901798/20110406161236156901798_.html|title=Profile of Zhang Xi at Tsinghua University, China|access-date=2020-08-22|archive-date=2020-07-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200703053512/http://www.chem.tsinghua.edu.cn/publish/chemen/2141/2011/20110406161236156901798/20110406161236156901798_.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> He then became associate dean of the faculty of science at the university. In 2018, he became the president of Jilin University.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.jlu.edu.cn/info/1155/44855.htm|title=Profile of Zhang Xi, President of Jilin University, China}}</ref>

==Awards==
Zhang was elected a member of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2007. He was awarded "Fellow" of the University of Tokyo in 2013.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.chem.tsinghua.edu.cn/publish/chemen/432/2013/20131230160314523407379/20131230160314523407379_.html|title=Prof. Xi Zhang was Awarded "Fellow, School of Engineering, The University of Tokyo"}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
